value.body: A medical billing executive turns a patient's treatment into a bill and makes sure the provider gets paid, whether by the patient, an insurer or a health scheme. Hospitals hire for in-house billing desks, and healthcare revenue-cycle management (RCM) firms hire for processes that bill overseas healthcare providers' claims. A typical day involves preparing bills, checking claim documents and following up on pending payments.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Hospital billing software, Excel, insurer portals

items.label: Work settings
items.value: Hospital billing desks; RCM process centres

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers join hospital billing counters or RCM process centres, often through campus or walk-in hiring. Night shifts are common in RCM roles that serve overseas clients.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Reading tariffs, packages and treatment codes

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: billing supervisor, AR analyst, revenue-cycle team lead.
Overlaps with TPA desk work; some people move between the two.
Process roles can be repetitive and target-driven.
